title: Count docs-only skipped or CI-reused checks as seen for 'still passes'
summary: The verdict's seen-running rule (D43, `judge` in verify.rs) now accepts a check Athena skipped by the docs-only path rule (`skip_when_only` note) as seen, when the change touches only docs. A passing CI-reused check already counts. This unblocks criteria like 'cargo test and cargo clippy still pass' on docs-only changes such as the many-agents design note. Audience: Athena's verifier and the user reading verdicts.

defaults_applied.how: Two new tests plus cargo test and clippy must stay clean.
Criteria call `judge` and check met and commands_verified.
The rule is fixed in the judge's seen-running rule, not by special-casing one job.
The verifier runs cargo test on the new tests.
One focused change in verify.rs, with minimal plumbing at callers.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs (`judge`: `ran` is built from checks with exit 0 or reused-without-exit on matching candidate/checks tree, lines ~370-395; unseen commands make a behavior criterion unmet at ~523-554; test helpers `check`, `reused_from_ci`, `judge_recorded`, and the existing test `a_skipped_check_that_was_not_reused_does_not_count_as_run` ~1991), crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs (`skip_note` writes 'not run: every changed path matches skip_when_only (...)' and `skipped_run` yields exit_code None, passed true, reused false), crates/athena-core/src/routing.rs (docs/design kinds skip fmt and clippy when only `docs/` or `*.md` changed), and the caller crates/athena-core/src/run/verification.rs:389 plus send_back.rs:264. The property is measured directly by calling `judge` and reading `criteria[i].met` and `commands_verified`; no reading/refusal rule or record file under crates/ is added, so records validation is not touched.

`judge` has no changed-path input today. The producer should either add a field such as `changed_paths` to `VerdictInputs` (and set it in verification.rs, send_back.rs and the verify.rs test constructors) and treat a check as seen only when every changed path is docs-only, or rely on the skip note. Preferring the path input, because a skipped record on a code change must not count. Docs-only means the same `docs/` and `*.md` patterns routing uses, ideally via the shared `path_matches` rather than a copy.

Only a skipped record whose note comes from the `skip_when_only` rule counts; a skip for another reason (for example 'not run: CI was not green') or a failed record still does not. The existing candidate-tree and checks-tree match condition stays.
The user said the files changed are verify.rs and its tests, so the run caller edits are minimal field plumbing only. No change to athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows is needed.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new test in crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs has a docs-only change (changed paths only under docs/ or *.md) with clippy skipped by the skip_when_only rule and test reused from GitHub CI. A criterion citing `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` is met, with commands_verified true and no D43 'cited but not seen running' finding. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify` to check.

A new test has a code change (a .rs path changed) with clippy recorded as skipped. A criterion citing `cargo clippy` is still unmet, with commands_verified false and the 'cited but not seen running' finding. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify` to check.

Existing tests still pass, including a_skipped_check_that_was_not_reused_does_not_count_as_run, a_failed_check_reused_from_ci_does_not_count_as_run and the other-tree tests; a skip for a reason other than the docs-only path rule, or a failed check, still does not count. Run `cargo test` and `cargo clippy --all-targets`.
The doc comments on `VerdictInputs`/`judge` in verify.rs state the new rule: a check skipped by the docs-only path rule on a docs-only change counts as seen, and name the docs-only definition used.

The change does not widen what counts as seen for non-docs changes. Run `cargo test -p athena-core` and read the diff with `git diff` to confirm the only new counting path is gated on docs-only changed paths.

out_of_scope: Changing which checks routing skips or the skip_when_only patterns
Changing how CI results are reused (ci_result.rs, checks.rs)
Re-running or re-landing the many-agents design note
Any change to athena.toml, defaults.toml, or .github/workflows
departures: Hard job: the change loosens the verdict gate, and plumbing a new input through callers adds some risk and cost.
urgent_reason: Rejected attempts at docs-only jobs are wasted work; this cuts that redo for docs-only changes.
hard_reason: It changes the verdict's seen-running rule (D43) in the gate that judges other jobs, so a mistake could let unverified criteria pass.
